ctx.x: To Joe, yeah. He went up to Joe, and he asked Joe if... And Joe told Frank he wanted a thousand dollars for the thing, but he had to sign something that he would take so much out of my pay each week to pay for it. So Frank said, "Okay. But I want to take the contract with me -- and you'll get your money." He signed the thing, and Frank's got the contract -- and the secretary snatched that thing out of his hand. He's still got that same secretary up there; she still works in the office, I think -- Miss Church.…
So then they called me. I called back down there, and they said "Everything's straight."
